instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: increased risk
items.definition: An increase in the probability of an event occuring, as compared to a background risk such as the normal risk in a given population. For intsance, the increased risk of getting breast cancer given a Brca1 mutation.

items.label: lipid homeostasis
items.definition: Any process involved in the maintenance of an internal steady state of lipid within an organism or cell.

items.label: iron ion homeostasis
items.definition: Any process involved in the maintenance of an internal steady state of iron ions within an organism or cell.

items.label: osteoarthritis biomarker measurement
items.definition: osteoarthritis biomarkers, such as  serum cartilage oligomeric protein (sCOMP) and urinary C-telopeptide of type II collagen (uCTX-II), are used as indicators for osteoarthritis screening and as predictors for therapeutic responses and prognoses in patients

items.label: recombination measurement
items.definition: quantification of any recombination-related factor, such as hotspot usage, African enchrichment and recombination rate

items.label: FEV change measurement
items.definition: quantification of the rate of change in FEV of an individual over the course of time, used as an indicator of improvement or decay of pulmonary function

items.label: parental genotype effect measurement
items.definition: quantification of the effect of the parental genotype, usually the maternal genotype on the development of a child, for example to determine its influence on congenital abnormalities

items.label: mammographic density measurement
items.definition: quantification of the density of breast tissue from a mammogram, used as an indicator of breast cancer risk

items.label: sexual dimorphism
items.definition: phenotypic differentiation between males and females of the same species, eg in size, coloration, behaviour or another characteristic.

items.label: sum of skinfolds
items.definition: quantification of skinfold thickness as a proxy for measuring the amount of adipose tissue

items.label: mitochondrial DNA measurement
items.definition: quantification of mitochondrial DNA in a sample, usually through genetic amplification of target genes by quantifiative real-time PCR

items.label: antidepressant-induced side effect
items.definition: any sign or symptom that is the direct result of treatment with antidepressant medication

items.label: transferrin saturation measurement
items.definition: The determination of the iron bound to transferrin in a sample.

items.label: total iron binding capacity
items.definition: The determination of the saturation of iron binding sites on serum transferrin proteins.

items.label: systolic blood pressure
items.definition: The blood pressure during the contraction of the left ventricle of the heart.

items.label: diastolic blood pressure
items.definition: The blood pressure after the contraction of the heart while the chambers of the heart refill with blood.

items.label: mean arterial pressure
items.definition: The mean pressure of the blood within the arterial circulation. The arterial pressure may be directly measured by insertion of an intra-arterial catheter connected to a transducer. The mean arterial pressure (MAP) can be calculated by subsequent analysis of the waveform. MAP can be approximated with

items.label: transferrin measurement
items.definition: The determination of the amount of transferrin present in a sample.

items.label: pulmonary artery enlargement
items.definition: PAE is defined as PA/A >1.

items.label: pulmonary artery-aorta diameter ratio measurement
items.definition: The ratio of the diameter of the pulmonary artery to the diameter of the aorta (PA/A) as measured using CT.

items.label: mammographic density percentage
items.definition: proportion of the total breast area that is dense

items.label: dense area measurement
items.definition: quantification of the area of the breast tissue that is dense, expressed in cm2

items.label: non-dense area measurement
items.definition: quantification of the area of the breast tissue that is non-dense, expressed in cm2

items.label: nicotine glucuronidation measurement
items.definition: quantification of nicotine metabolisation via the glucuronidation pathway, usually via analysis of a urine sample

items.label: cotinine glucuronidation measurement
items.definition: quantification of cotinine metabolisation via the glucuronidation pathway, usually via analysis of a urine sample

items.label: angiographic measurement
items.definition: quantification of some heart-related structural phenotype via the medical imaging technique of angiography, for example to determine the number or type of coronary artery lesions in coronary artery disease

items.label: carbon monoxide exhalation measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of carbon monoxide in a person's exhalation, usually measured using a breath CO monitor. Breath CO can be used for evaluation of smoking status or assessment of carbon monoxide poisoning

items.label: calcium intake measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of calcium consumed from dietary and supplemental sources

items.label: asymmetrical dimethylarginine measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of asymmetrical dimethylarginine in blood. Asymmetric dimethylarginine (ADMA) is an independent risk factor for coronary heart disease in patients with heart disease, type II diabetes or kidney disease. ADMA inhibits nitric oxide (NO) synthesis and is elevated in disease

items.label: symmetrical dimethylarginine measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of asymmetrical dimethylarginine in blood. It is a structural isomer of asymmetric dimethyl argigine. It has been reported to be a marker for kidney disease,  often used a predictor of all-cause mortality after ischemic stroke

items.label: L-arginine measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of L-arginine in a sample, eg in blood

items.label: coffee consumption measurement
items.definition: the quantification of some coffee consumption or coffee consumption-related behaviour, usually self-reported via a questionnaire

items.label: psychosocial stress measurement
items.definition: the quantification of psychosocial stress factors such as financial strain, marital problems, work-related difficulties or health problems, usually assessed through self-reporting via standardised questionnaires.

items.label: body height at birth
items.definition: The distance from the sole to the crown of the head of a newborn right after birth

items.label: infant body height
items.definition: The distance from the sole to the crown of the head of an infant, which can be used as a proxy for skeletal growth in early life

items.label: left inferior lateral ventricle volume measurement
items.definition: quantification of the volume of the left inferior lateral ventricle, usuallly through an MRI scan

items.label: neurofibrillary tangles measurement
items.definition: quantification of the presence and amount of neurofibrillary tangles, pathological protein aggregates formed by hyperphosphorylation of a microtubule-associated protein known as tau

items.label: word list delayed recall measurement
items.definition: Word list delayed recall is a verabl declarative memory test using visually or verbally presented word lists, with or without semantic relatedness between words, with articipants being asked to remember as many words as possible after a specified delay interval, The test is used to quanitfy memory p

items.label: paragraph delayed recall measurement
items.definition: Paragraph delayed recall is a verabl declarative memory test using one or two verbally presented stories, with articipants being asked to remember as many paragraph elements as possible after a specified delay interval, The test is used to quanitfy memory performance.

items.label: yang deficiency

items.label: stricture
items.definition: abnormal narrowing in a blood vessel or other tubular organ or structure

items.label: mild disease course
items.definition: progression of a disease with symptoms at the milder end of the spectrum for that condition

items.label: complicated disease course
items.definition: progression of a disease with severe or complex symptoms within the spectrum of that condition

items.label: GFR change measurement
items.definition: A quantification of the variation in an individual's glomerular filtration rate (GFR) over a period of time used in assessment of kidney function and diagnosis of kidney disease.

items.label: insulin metabolic clearance rate measurement
items.definition: quantification of the rate at which insulin is cleared from some part of the metabolism, eg from the blood

items.label: acute insulin response measurement
items.definition: quantification of insulin release in response to a controlled glucose intake, generally  calculated as the increase in insulin concentrations at 2–8 min above the basal (fasting) insulin level after the bolus glucose injection at 0–1 min

items.label: disposition index measurement
items.definition: quantification of the disposition index, the product of measures of insulin sensitivity and firstphase insulin secretion, shown to predict conversion to diabetes

items.label: glucose effectiveness measurement
items.definition: quantification of glucose effectiveness, the capacity of glucose to enhance its own cellular uptake and to suppress endogenous glucose production

items.label: rapid kidney function decline
items.definition: decline in kidney function defined as a decline in glomerular filtration rate in one year of  > 3 ml/min per 1.73m2

items.label: respiratory disease biomarker
items.definition: The quantitation of a biomarker used in the measurement of lung fuction used in diagnosis or management of a clinical condition.

items.label: infectious disease biomarker
items.definition: A quantification of some biomarker used in the diagnosis or management of infectious disease.

items.label: liver disease biomarker
items.definition: The quantification of biomarkers used in the diagnosis or management of liver disease

items.label: autoimmune disease biomarker
items.definition: Is a quantification of some substance or anatomical feature used as an indicator of biological state

items.label: mental or behavioural disorder biomarker
items.definition: Is the quantification of some marker used in the diagnosis or clinical management of some mental or behavioural disorder.

items.label: malignant
items.definition: Refers to abnormal cell activity manifested by decreased control over growth and function, causing tumor growth or spread into surrounding tissue and adverse effects to the host

items.label: metastatic
items.definition: A term referring the clinical or pathological observation of a tumor extension from its original site of growth to another anatomic site.

items.label: breastfeeding duration
items.definition: breastfeeding duration is a measurement of the mean number of months each mother breastfed each child, averaged across all live births and standardized to a Z-score

items.label: skin conductance level
items.definition: The skin conductance level is a baseline measure that changes slowly with altered arousal state. SCL is measured as the median response during a 5-min relaxation period.

items.label: skin conductance response frequency
items.definition: quantification of the number of valid skin conductance change responses, used to gauge an individual's resistance to habituation

items.label: alpha wave measurement
items.definition: quantification of the wave-like oscillations in the alpha band (8-13 Hz) of electric potential between parts of the brain

items.label: beta wave measurement
items.definition: quantification of the wave-like oscillations in the beta band (13-30 Hz) of electric potential between parts of the brain

items.label: delta wave measurement
items.definition: quantification of the wave-like oscillations in the delta band (0.1-4 Hz) of electric potential between parts of the brain

items.label: theta wave measurement
items.definition: quantification of the wave-like oscillations in the theta band (4-8 Hz) of electric potential between parts of the brain

items.label: antisaccade response measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the error rate reflecting the proportion of trials in an antisaccade task that resulted in a prosaccade response. An antisaccade task invovles the suppression of the involuntary saccade towards a stimulus (prosaccade response) following a period of fixation on a motionless target.

items.label: acoustic startle blink response measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's eye blink response to a startling acoustic stimulus, measured via electrodes placed on the orbicularis oculi muscle

items.label: alpha peak frequency measurement
items.definition: quantification of the dominant frequency of the alpha band

items.label: radiologic finding
items.definition: Imaging results obtained through a radiology procedure.

items.label: proliferative inflammatory atrophy
items.definition: A lesion in the prostate gland characterized by glandular atrophy, chronic inflammation, and epithelial hyperplasia.  It has been suggested that it is a precancerous lesion and it may lead to the development of prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia and prostatic carcinoma.

items.label: airway responsiveness measurement
items.definition: quantification of airway responsiveness, calculated as the concentration of methacholine at which a greater than 20% decresase in FEV1 is achieved during a bronchial challenge test

items.label: airway wall thickness measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the thickness of the walls of different parts of the respiratory tract, calculated from cross-sectional CT images. This measure can be used as an indicator of airway obstruction severity in COPD.

items.label: prefrontal cortex cytoarchtiectural measurement
items.definition: quantification of the cytoarchitecture, ie the cellular composition, of the prefrontal cortex of the brain

items.label: spontaneous preterm birth
items.definition: any birth that occurs spontaneously prior to 37 weeks of gestation, eg due to fetal membrane rupture or spontaneous onset of uterine contractions

items.label: female fertility
items.definition: A fertility quality of inhering in a female by virtue of the bearer's disposition to initiate, sustain, or support reproduction.

items.label: birth measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of birth, eg whether it preterm or full term

items.label: delivery measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of delivery, eg whether it occured preterm or at full term

items.label: household air pollution measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of air pollution in the home, eg from coal burning for cooking and heating, used as an environmental risk factor for lung cancer

items.label: lipoprotein A measurement
items.definition: quantification of some lipoprotein A in a sample

items.label: motion sickness
items.definition: sympton caused by motion, as sea sickness, train sickness, car sickness, air sickness, or space motion sickness. It may include nausea, vomiting and dizziness.

items.label: IgG index
items.definition: the IgG index (or CSF index) is the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) IgG to CSF albumin ration compared to the serum IgG to serum albumin ratio. It is an indicator of the relative amount IgG in CSF compared to serum

items.label: thalamus volume
items.definition: quantification of the volume of the thalamus, a midline symmetrical structure of two halves, within the vertebrate brain, situated between the cerebral cortex and the midbrain

items.label: optic rim area measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of the rim of the optic disc

items.label: cup-to-disc ratio measurement
items.definition: Is a quantification of the ratio between optic cup and optic disc, used in the diagnosis of glaucoma

items.label: grip strength measurement
items.definition: quantification of the force applied by the hand to pull on or suspend from objects

items.label: blood pressure change measurement
items.definition: quantification of any change in an indiviual's blood pressure, for example in response to treatment with a antihypertensive agent

items.label: systolic blood pressure change measurement
items.definition: quantification of any change in an indiviual's systolic blood pressure

items.label: diastolic blood pressure change measurement
items.definition: quantification of any change in an indiviual's diastolic blood pressure

items.label: red wine liking measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's appreciation of red wine

items.label: white wine liking measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's appreciation of white wine

items.label: wine liking measurement
items.definition: quantification of an individual's appreciation of wine

items.label: cytotoxicity measurement
items.definition: quantification of some aspect of cytotoxity such as survival time or cell viability

items.label: family history of lung cancer
items.definition: A reported family history of lung cancer in one or more family members.

items.label: intraocular pressure change measurement
items.definition: quantification of the difference in intraocular pressure between two time points

items.label: X12063 measurement
items.definition: quantification of the unknown substance X12063 in blood

items.label: mannose measurement
items.definition: quantification of mannose in a sample

items.label: gene methylation measurement
items.definition: quantification of the amount of DNA methylation in a target gene

items.label: endophenotype
items.definition: Measurable biological (physiological, biochemical, and anatomical features), behavioral (psychometric pattern) or cognitive markers that are found more often in individuals with a disease than in the general population. Because many endophenotypes are present before the disease onset and in individu

items.label: cancer aggressiveness measurement
items.definition: quantification of the agressiveness of a (usually malignant) cancer

items.label: Gleason score measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the cytoarchitecture of a prostate cancer sample, used in the evaluation of cancer prognosis. Cancers with a higher Gleason score are generally more aggressive and have a worse prognosis.

items.label: dehydroepiandrosterone sulphate measurement
items.definition: Quantification of dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate (DHEA-S) in a sample. DHEA-S is a metabolite of dehydroepiandrosterone (DHEA), the most abundant circulating steroid hormone in humans.
